method: Axis = medial->lateral epicondyle of the distal humerus; centre = centroid of the lowest 15 mm of the humerus, then offset. Offset chosen by grid search (dy, dz in -6..+6 mm) minimising forearm-into-humerus penetration at 45/90/120 deg while keeping the joint gap close to the rest value. Evidence: qa/calibration_search.json
